mechanism: Both drugs cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium), with amphotericin B inducing renal tubular damage and furosemide promoting urinary losses, leading to severe hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, and acute kidney injury.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, electrolytes (K+, Mg2+) closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; use lowest effective furosemide dose; supplement potassium and magnesium; ensure adequate hydration; consider potassium-sparing diuretic or ACE inhibitor.
